keys.title: Audio8 voice
keys.help: Which registered Audio8 voice speaks. Empty uses the voice packaged with the export. Register more with `obey-voice voices register`.

keys.title: Thinking sounds
keys.help: Plays a short "mm-hm" while a slow answer is still coming, so the pause doesn't feel dead.

keys.title: Barge-in
keys.help: Lets you talk over her. Needs the voice front-end on, and only affects this Mac's microphone — phone clients still need the interrupt button.

keys.title: Who can interrupt
keys.help: enrolled_only lets only an enrolled voice cut her off; it fails open (anyone can interrupt) whenever live speaker recognition is off, cold, or unhealthy — a privacy guard, not an auth boundary.

keys.title: Barge-in echo tail guard
keys.help: How long after playback pauses to ignore the mic, so speaker echo trailing off doesn't trip a false barge-in.

keys.title: Barge-in speech confidence
keys.help: How sure the barge-in detector must be that mic audio is real speech before cutting her off. Lower it toward 0.6 once voice_frontend=webrtc is doing the echo cancellation.

keys.title: Microphone
keys.help: Which microphone she listens to. Empty follows the system input device.

keys.title: Speaker
keys.help: Where her voice plays. Empty follows the system output device.

keys.title: Speaking rate
keys.help: How fast she talks. Above about 1.3 the words start to slur.

keys.title: Talk hotkey combo
keys.help: Modifiers plus a key, like alt+space or ctrl+alt+t. Needs at least one of ctrl, alt or cmd, or a bare function key. Empty uses the platform default: ⌥Space on macOS, Ctrl+Alt+Space on Windows; on Linux the key is whatever you bind to `obey-voice talk`.

keys.title: Talk hotkey
keys.help: Lets a system-wide key start and end a spoken turn from any app. macOS and Windows register the combo themselves; elsewhere bind your shortcut tool to `obey-voice talk`. Ctrl+G stays the mute.

keys.title: Talk hotkey mode
keys.help: hold = press to talk, release to send; toggle = tap to start, tap to send; automatic = tap toggles, holding longer than 300 ms is a hold.

keys.title: Require the speech computer
keys.help: Refuses to start a conversation when the speech computer is unreachable, instead of speaking in the fallback voice.

keys.title: Speech computer timeout
keys.help: How long to wait for the speech computer to answer a connection. It does not bound the model load on a cold host.

keys.title: Where speech runs
keys.help: Whether Qwen speaks on this computer or on another one running speech-serve. Kokoro always speaks here.

keys.title: Speech engine
keys.help: Which engine speaks. Kokoro is fastest; Qwen sounds richer and costs latency.

keys.title: Kokoro voice
keys.help: The voice Kokoro speaks in. Qwen ignores this and uses its own preset.

keys.title: Speech computer token
keys.help: The shared secret that speech computer requires. Empty falls back to the OBEY_SPEECH_TOKEN environment variable.

keys.title: Speech computer address
keys.help: The speech-serve host to send text to, like https://studio:7263. Only used when speech runs on another computer.

keys.title: Detect speech automatically
keys.help: Ends your turn when you stop talking. Off means every turn waits for the listen timeout.

keys.title: Shortest utterance
keys.help: Sound shorter than this is treated as noise, so a cough never starts a turn.

keys.title: Pre-speech audio
keys.help: Audio kept from just before speech is detected, so your first word isn't clipped.

keys.title: End-of-turn silence
keys.help: Seconds of quiet that end your turn. Lower feels snappier; too low cuts you off mid-sentence.

keys.title: Speech confidence
keys.help: How sure she must be that a sound is speech. Raise it in a noisy room; too high drops quiet talkers.

keys.title: Fallback engine
keys.help: When the main engine is slow or fails, speak that sentence in this engine instead. disabled waits for the main engine (you hear Qwen, not Kokoro).

keys.title: Voice front-end
keys.help: Runs echo cancellation on this Mac's microphone before speech detection. webrtc needs a build with the apm tag; nlms is the built-in fallback. Required for barge-in.

keys.title: Noise suppression level
keys.help: How aggressively the webrtc front-end suppresses background noise, from 0 (off) to 3 (aggressive). No effect on nlms or off.

keys.title: Model provider
keys.help: Who answers. Ollama runs on this Mac; Claude, Cursor, and Grok call out to their CLIs.

keys.title: Claude session cap
keys.help: Starts a fresh Claude session once the replayed prompt passes this size. 0 keeps resuming forever.

keys.title: Claude session warning
keys.help: Warns once when a Claude session's replayed prompt passes this size. Nothing is dropped. 0 disables the warning.

keys.title: Context integrity checks
keys.help: Detect truncated Ollama completions and emit continuity events. Off restores pre-continuity behavior.

keys.title: Cursor model
keys.help: The model cursor-agent is asked for. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

keys.title: Machine context
keys.help: Tells the model your user name, host and OS so it can answer questions about this machine.

keys.title: Grok model
keys.help: The model the Grok CLI is asked for. Empty uses the CLI's own default.

keys.title: Remembered turns
keys.help: How many past exchanges she carries into the next answer. More context costs latency.

keys.title: Ollama server
keys.help: Where Ollama is running. Point it at another machine to answer from there.

keys.title: Model residency
keys.help: How long Ollama keeps the model in memory between turns. Shorter frees RAM but pays the load cost again.

keys.title: Ollama model
keys.help: The local model Ollama loads. Empty picks the first installed model.

keys.title: Prompt batch size
keys.help: How much of the prompt is re-read each turn. Smaller lets Ollama reuse more of an unchanged conversation, which is a large win to the first word on qwen3.8-class models, and costs a little on brand-new prompts. 0 lets Ollama choose.

keys.title: Context window
keys.help: How much conversation the local model sees. 0 uses the server's own size, which silently drops the oldest turns.

keys.title: Reasoning
keys.help: auto/false leave thinking off so greetings are not a minute of silent CoT. Set true or low/medium/high/max to enable it.

keys.title: Speaker recognition
keys.help: Master switch. Off means no speaker models load and nobody is ever labelled.

keys.title: Enrolled voices folder
keys.help: Where enrolled voice profiles are stored. Empty uses the folder inside Obey Voice's install root.

keys.title: Live speaker labels
keys.help: Labels who is speaking during a conversation, not just afterwards in meetings.

keys.title: Live label mode
keys.help: Indicator only shows who is talking; owner-verify also ignores turns from anyone but you when it is confident.

keys.title: Live match confidence
keys.help: Match cutoff for live labels. 0 inherits the general match confidence.

keys.title: Live analysis window
keys.help: Must match the window used when speakers were enrolled — a mismatch roughly doubles missed matches.

keys.title: Match confidence
keys.help: How close a voice must be to an enrolled profile to count as that person. Higher misses more; lower mislabels more.

keys.title: Your name
keys.help: The name the agent uses for you in prompts and chat labels instead of speaker-1. Empty keeps the operating-system user and anonymous labels.

keys.title: Meetings folder
keys.help: Where recorded meetings and their notes are written. Empty uses the folder inside Obey Voice's install root.

keys.title: Exported body
keys.help: Both options include the full transcript in what gets exported.

keys.title: Default destination
keys.help: The destination auto exports to, and the one preselected when she asks.

keys.title: Route destinations
keys.help: Named export targets for meeting notes.

keys.title: Export notes
keys.help: Ask prompts after every meeting, auto exports straight to the default destination, off never exports.

keys.title: Diarization engine
keys.help: Which model splits a finished recording by speaker. Sortformer is optional, needs the transcribe.cpp CLI plus its weights, and ignores the expected-speaker count.

keys.title: Identify speakers in meetings
keys.help: Splits a finished recording by speaker so the transcript says who said what.

keys.title: Label while recording
keys.help: Shows provisional speaker labels during the meeting; the final pass still corrects them.

keys.title: Expected speakers
keys.help: Fixes how many people the analysis splits the room into. 0 lets it work that out.

keys.title: Keep meeting audio
keys.help: Keeps the meeting audio file. Without it, speakers can't be re-analysed after the meeting ends.

keys.title: Skill matching model
keys.help: The embedding model that decides which skill fits a request. Empty falls back to name matching only.

keys.title: Skills folder
keys.help: An extra folder scanned for skills. Empty uses the folder inside Obey Voice's install root.

keys.title: Disabled skills
keys.help: Skills the agent ignores even when discovered.

keys.title: Skills
keys.help: Loads SKILL.md instruction packs into her prompt. Ollama only.

keys.title: Skill match cutoff
keys.help: How close a request must be to a skill before it is offered. Higher offers fewer, more relevant skills.

keys.title: Command timeout
keys.help: How long one command may run before it is killed. Long builds need a bigger number.

keys.title: Local tools
keys.help: Lets her read files and run commands on this Mac for you. Off makes tool-capable models look broken.

keys.title: Working folder
keys.help: The folder the agent's file and shell tools start in — a default, not a sandbox. Empty uses the folder it was launched from, or your home folder when that is the binary's own folder.

keys.title: Tools for network turns
keys.help: Lets turns that arrive over the network run tools on this Mac. Off by default — a phone or browser can otherwise run commands here.

keys.title: Agent name
keys.help: What the agent calls itself. The active persona overrides this when one sets a display name.

keys.title: ebook-convert path
keys.help: Where the ebook-convert command lives. Empty looks it up on PATH.

keys.title: Calibre library
keys.help: Lets her read books out of your Calibre library for audiobook narration.

keys.title: Calibre library folder
keys.help: The library Calibre commands run against. Empty uses Calibre's own default library.

keys.title: Preferred book format
keys.help: Which format she reads when a book has several. Anything else is converted first.

keys.title: calibredb path
keys.help: Where the calibredb command lives. Empty looks it up on PATH.

keys.title: Compact instruction
keys.help: The prompt document used when a conversation is compacted. Empty uses the built-in one.

keys.title: Language
keys.help: The locale speech recognition and speech synthesis assume. Changing it needs models for that language.

keys.title: Wait for speech
keys.help: How long she waits for you to start talking before giving up on the turn.

keys.title: Longest utterance
keys.help: The longest single stretch of speech she will transcribe before ending the turn for you.

keys.title: Prompts folder
keys.help: Where prompt documents are read from. Empty uses the folder inside Obey Voice's install root.

keys.title: Models folder
keys.help: Where downloaded voice and speech models are cached. Moving it re-downloads everything.

keys.title: Parakeet model
keys.help: Which NVIDIA Parakeet TDT model the sherpa-parakeet provider loads. tdt-0.6b-v2 is English and the most accurate; tdt-0.6b-v3 adds 25 languages; tdt-110m is small and fast.

keys.title: Qwen worker path
keys.help: An external Qwen worker to use instead of the installed one. Empty uses Obey Voice's own.

keys.title: Cloning consent
keys.help: Confirms you have permission to clone the reference voice. Cloning refuses without it.

keys.title: Qwen delivery notes
keys.help: Free-text direction for how Qwen performs a line. The 0.6b tier ignores it.

keys.title: Qwen language
keys.help: The language Qwen speaks. Auto follows the text.

keys.title: Qwen voice mode
keys.help: How the Qwen voice is chosen. Empty means the built-in presets.

keys.title: Qwen model folder
keys.help: The model an external Qwen worker loads. Empty uses the installed package.

keys.title: Qwen model size
keys.help: Which installed Qwen model speaks. 1.7b sounds better and is slower.

keys.title: Qwen package digest
keys.help: Checksum the downloaded Qwen package must match. Empty skips the check.

keys.title: Qwen package URL
keys.help: Where the Qwen package is fetched from. Empty uses the release Obey Voice pins.

keys.title: Reference recording
keys.help: A WAV of the voice to clone. Only used by the cloning modes.

keys.title: Reference transcript
keys.help: Exactly what is said in the reference recording. A wrong transcript degrades the clone.

keys.title: Qwen chunk playback
keys.help: Whether Qwen starts speaking on its first chunk instead of the finished sentence. Auto only does it where that was measured not to stutter.

keys.title: Qwen request timeout
keys.help: How long one Qwen synthesis may take before it is abandoned and the fallback engine speaks.

keys.title: Qwen voice
keys.help: Which Qwen voice speaks. Empty uses Veronica (shipped clone).

keys.title: Streaming model
keys.help: The zipformer model used in streaming mode.

keys.title: Voice embedding model
keys.help: Overrides the model that turns a voice into a fingerprint. Empty uses the bundled one.

keys.title: Speaker segmentation model
keys.help: Overrides the model that splits a recording by speaker. Empty uses the bundled one.

keys.title: Transcription mode
keys.help: Streaming transcribes as you speak; offline waits for the end of your turn and is more accurate.

keys.title: Transcription engine
keys.help: Which engine turns your speech into text. Sherpa runs locally and fastest.

keys.title: transcribe.cpp path
keys.help: Where the transcribe.cpp command lives. A bare name is looked up on PATH, then in the copy models ensure installs; a path set here wins over both.

keys.title: transcribe.cpp model
keys.help: Which GGUF the optional transcribecpp provider loads. The value is upstream's full model slug, so it reads longer than parakeet_model's — that is not a typo.

keys.title: Whisper size
keys.help: Which Whisper model size sherpa loads. Bigger is more accurate and slower.

keys.title: Quantized weights
keys.help: Prefers int8 weights: much less memory, marginally less accurate.

keys.title: whisper.cpp path
keys.help: Where the whisper.cpp command lives. A bare name is looked up on PATH.

keys.title: whisper.cpp model
keys.help: Which ggml model whisper.cpp loads.

keys.title: whisper.cpp model file
keys.help: The exact ggml file to load, when it is not in the models folder.

keys.title: Active persona
keys.help: Set by the Personas screen.

keys.title: Persona prompt
keys.help: Set by the Personas screen.

keys.title: TUI mouse capture
keys.help: Set from the terminal app; it has no effect on this Mac app.

keys.title: Voice front-end (legacy)
keys.help: Superseded by voice_frontend (webrtc/nlms/off). Ignored once voice_frontend is set explicitly.
